message.content: For California Secretary of State, Shirley N. Weber issued a statement on October 12, 2023 condemning the attack on Israel while expressing sympathy for both Israeli and Palestinian civilians, calling for an end to the conflict and addressing its underlying causes. She has not called the campaign a genocide or publicly backed blocking weapons transfers to Israel. Weber holds an endorsement from CAIR Action and a supported rating from Vote for Peace, both Muslim-community and pro-Palestine-aligned organizations, alongside an endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, an Israel-aligned group. Her Republican opponent, Don Wagner, carries an opposed rating from Vote for Peace with no documented statement or action on Gaza. Weber's documented expression of sympathy for Palestinian civilians and her call for an end to the conflict, paired with her standing with CAIR Action and Vote for Peace, sets her apart from a candidate rated opposed by that same guide.
